notes: Timeline view is now a full-screen CapCut/Filmora-style editor. The selected scene card + the timeline dock move into a dedicated full-window workspace: Content rail (left), large preview (centre), text/layer properties (right), and the multi-track Voice/Text/Media timeline full-width along the bottom. Slim top bar with Exit (or Esc), scene counter, + Scene, and Generate; the app chrome is hidden and the old full-width 'Add Scene' row is gone. Clicking a scene block swaps the mounted scene; hardened so reloading in Timeline mode can't leave duplicate cards. Storyboard/List are unchanged.
